speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me understand your condition better, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and exactly when your symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise at 30 weeks gestation, combined with ice cream consumption three days ago, raises concern for Listeria monocytogenes infection. REQUEST TEST: Blood culture and serum lactate levels. Are you experiencing any stiff neck, photophobia, or abdominal pain?
